cohort: 425 patients with preterm premature rupture of membranes between 28 and 34 weeks of gestation who delivered infants at Shandong Provincial Hospitals between January 1, 2013 and December 31, 2019
finding: CRP level (<19.69 mg/L), WBC count (<12.99 x 109/L), and PCT level (<0.054 ng/mL) demonstrated good negative predictive values for chorioamnionitis, while their positive predictive values were low, with CRP level being the most accurate predictor among patients with PPROM from 28 to 34 weeks of gestation.
